neighbours.label: The word 'spin' in its physics sense (the intrinsic angular momentum of a particle or nucleus), vs 'spin' in other senses (spin class, political spin, a car spinning) and physics sentences without the word
fire: In the magnetic field, each proton's spin lines up either with or against the field.

Pauli showed that two electrons in one orbital must have opposite spin values.
MRI scanners work by tipping the nuclear spin of hydrogen atoms in the body.
Quarks are fermions with a spin of one half, like the electron.

Photons are bosons, and their spin is one in units of the reduced Planck constant.
In the Stern-Gerlach experiment, silver atoms split into two beams by spin direction.

The car hit a patch of ice and went into a spin on the motorway.
